trap.label: dangling participle
trap.wrong: Having spoken, the room was quiet.
trap.why: Em português aceitamos sujeitos diferentes. Em inglês, o particípio inicial refere-se ao sujeito da principal: “Having spoken, I wait.”

mcq.q: Passive participle: ___ by noise, he left.

fix.wrong: Having spoken, the room was quiet.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After I had spoken, I sat down.”
Particípio passivo: “He was disturbed by noise, so he left.”
Negativa: “Because she had not finished, she stayed.”
